messages:
julie (People Ops): @michael quick question — contractor in Mexico (Andrés) moved from US mid‑Mar and is now Mexican tax resident per his TIN. He still invoices us as a contractor from his MX company. Do we need to start withholding ISR or change payment flow?

michael (Payroll): short answer: depends. If he's invoicing via an MX legal entity (RFC) and we treat as vendor, we usually don't withhold payroll taxes. But if he's now an employee or working under 'personal services' rules, there may be obligations and potential withholding.

sofia (Finance): We need docs: RFC + CFDI sample, legal form, and proof of entity vs individual. If he's a 'persona física' issuing CFDI, we may need to withhold and remit ISR/IMSS in some cases.

julie (People Ops): He submitted RFC + CFDI sample. He's not on benefits, still contractor flow. He asked to make sure his net after tax is same as before — wants us to gross up if we withhold.

michael (Payroll): Next steps: 1) confirm issuer type on CFDI, 2) run withholding estimate, 3) decide gross-up. I need his monthly invoice amounts and exact start/move dates. @andres can you attach the invoice?

andres (Contracting): Attached invoice (link). Amount: MXN 85,000 monthly, started 2026-03-15. Confirming he's still billing from an MX entidad.

sofia (Finance): If we gross-up we'll need GL impact approval and a PO. Pinging @trevor for signoff once we have numbers.

trevor (Finance Lead): Ack. One-time gross-up is ok; need estimate and accounting treatment before payout.

michael (Payroll): Running calc now. Preliminary: if treated as persona física with servicios profesionales, ISR withholding ~10-12% after basic allowances; IMSS depends on benefit enrollment — likely employer obligations if we classify as employee. Will post a simple spreadsheet soon.

payroll-bot: Ticket #PR-2026-987 created for "MX contractor withholding review" and assigned to @michael. ETA 2 business days.

julie (People Ops): Also flag: he was US-based earlier this year — we need to reconcile US payroll withholding for Jan–Mar and check W-2/1099 classification. I'll pull his US paystub.

michael (Payroll): Good call. I'll coordinate with US payroll for any retro adjustments and determine whether we issue a corrected W-2 or 1099. Might also affect state withholding.

sofia (Finance): Checklist link for reference: /docs/payroll/international/latam-onboarding.md — includes docs we need and sample accounting entries.

michael (Payroll): Uploaded the estimation spreadsheet to the ticket in 20m. If julie confirms gross-up, we'll need PO and approval chain before issuing payment.

julie (People Ops): Thanks all. Will confirm with Andrés and update this thread. :thumbsup:
